_m2_8_audit: M2.8 CLOSED (2026-08-05): deps.json completeness gate. Full harvested inventory reconciled 1:1 against the ledger — 98 static archives on disk (31 lib/wasm/lib + 4 lib/wasm/shaderc/lib + 63 lib/wasm/tint/lib) plus the header-only harvests (eigen, robinmap) and the OIIO-bundled pugixml, every one mapping to a `wasm_built` entry carrying {license (SPDX id), gpl_compatible, rationale, source}. The shader-chain transitive closure that ships as its own archives but has no dedicated harvest script (shaderc's glslang; Tint's SPIRV-Tools, SPIRV-Headers, abseil, dawn_shared_utils) is now enumerated as structured `bundled` sub-entries under the shaderc/tint parents (version pin + SPDX license + gpl_compatible + runtime_linked), promoting the earlier prose to auditable records. Build-time-only / native-harness deps recorded under `toolchain` with build_time:true. FINDING (unchanged): every SHIPPED runtime dep is GPL-compatible under Blender's GPL-2.0-or-later — the Apache-2.0 deps (oneTBB, OpenImageIO, shaderc/glslang, Tint's SPIRV-Tools+abseil) and the one MPL-2.0 dep (Eigen) are GPL-compatible via the or-later→GPLv3 path / MPL-2.0's GPL-compat clause (same posture as upstream Blender, which is GPL-2.0-or-later precisely to combine with them). NO GPL-incompatible runtime dep — no red flag. Versions/hashes cross-checked against upstream/build_files/build_environment/cmake/versions.cmake at the pin; shader-closure pins against notes/deps-shader-chain.md (Dawn chromium/7989).

TBB) evaluators; every GPU API backend (OpenGL/Metal/CUDA/OpenCL/DX) OFF under Emscripten. libosdCPU.a contains 49 evaluator/topology objects. libosdGPU.a is a real 200,032-byte two-object archive (version.cpp.o and glslPatchShaderSource.cpp.o) exporting GLSLPatchShaderSource::GetPatchBasisShaderSource for Blender's WebGPU subdivision shader compiler, while the dependency recipe rejects OpenGL API objects and symbols. tint.rationale: SPIR-V(1.3)->WGSL back of the BROWSER shader chain: Tint SPV reader + WGSL writer subset (ReadIR->ProgramFromIR->Generate). Browsers accept WGSL only; SPIR-V modules throw. Runtime dep compiled into blender.wasm. GOAL shader-chain decision (tint-compiles-to-wasm precedent).

tint.notes: Cross-compiled to wasm (emcc 6.0.5, -pthread, static). Tint-only configure: TINT_BUILD_SPV_READER+WGSL_WRITER ON, all other writers/CMD/tests OFF; IR_VALIDATION_ASSERTS+IR_DUMPING OFF (internal debug self-check; overflowed the wasm stack, no effect on output). Dawn's third_party/CMakeLists.txt:119 `if(EMSCRIPTEN) return()` skips SPIRV-Tools under emscripten, so tint.sh uses a thin wrapper CMake that adds SPIRV-Headers+SPIRV-Tools BEFORE Dawn (non-invasive; shared checkout untouched). Harvest lib/wasm/tint/{lib(63 archives, 25MB: 50 libtint_*.a + the SINGLE libSPIRV-Tools{,-opt}.a shared with shaderc + 10 libabsl_*.a + libdawn_shared_utils.a),tint-archives.txt(ordered link list),include/README.txt(headers consumed from Dawn src)}. LINK SMOKE: shaderc+Tint in one wasm binary, GLSL vert->SPIR-V1.3->Tint->WGSL runs under node, WGSL BYTE-IDENTICAL to the native chain (sandbox/wgpu-shader-wasm-smoke). Needs -sSTACK_SIZE multi-MB (emscripten 64KB default overflows glslang/Tint recursion).

Static -pthread, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF, BROTLI_DISABLE_TESTS=ON. brotli 1.0.9 auto-detects BROTLI_BUNDLED_MODE=ON under emcmake so its install() is a no-op; archives harvested directly (libbrotli{common,dec,enc}-static.a + c/include/brotli/*.h). FindBrotli.cmake resolves via BROTLI_ROOT_DIR=lib/wasm. scripts/deps/brotli.sh

freetype.rationale: Font rendering. REQUIRED and NOT deferrable — no WITH_FREETYPE off-switch and check_freetype_for_brotli() FATALs without a brotli-enabled freetype. Dual FreeType-License (FTL) / GPL-2.0-or-later; both are GPL-compatible. See notes/deps-freetype.md.
freetype.source: versions.cmake:194 FREETYPE_VERSION 2.13.3 (MD5 ac1f0b517f62bd40d50bc995faa5741d); built by scripts/deps/freetype.sh
freetype.notes: REQUIRED, NOT deferrable: no WITH_FREETYPE off-switch; check_freetype_for_brotli() FATALs without brotli-enabled freetype. Static -pthread; FT_REQUIRE_BROTLI=ON + FT_REQUIRE_ZLIB=ON, FT_DISABLE_{BZIP2,HARFBUZZ,PNG}=ON, links lib/wasm brotli+zlib. Installs libfreetype.a (no 2ST postfix) + include/freetype2/. FT_CONFIG_OPTION_USE_BROTLI baked into installed ftoption.h (script asserts). scripts/deps/freetype.sh. See notes/deps-freetype.md

python.hash_provenance: versions.cmake:385 (PYTHON_HASH, MD5) — verified against downloaded tarball
python.rationale: WITH_PYTHON mandatory for bpy/UI (D-4); Blender 5.2 pins exactly 3.13 (FindPythonLibsUnix hardcodes 3.13).
python.notes: M2.1/M2.2 (2026-08-03). Vanilla CPython 3.13.13 static libpython3.13.a for wasm32-emscripten, browser target, JS-EH (-fexceptions; SUPPORT_LONGJMP defaults emscripten) per ADR-001 appendix + M2.0b probe (notes/python-emcc605-probe.md) — matches the JS-EH deps stack, zero dep rebuild. ZERO source patches on emcc 6.0.5 (3.13.13 ships in-tree Python/emscripten_trampoline.c; LONG_BIT not hit). Native bootstrap python.exe (macOS case-insensitive FS) via --with-build-python. Harvest is unix-layout / FindPythonLibsUnix-ready: lib/libpython3.13.a (42.2MB, 2850 defined-T syms = probe parity), include/python3.13/ (Python.h + cpython/ + internal/ + pyconfig.h), lib/python3.13/ (unzipped stdlib incl. build-generated _sysconfigdata__emscripten_wasm32-emscripten.py; CPython test suite excluded). Optional modules absent — need deps not yet harvested: _ctypes(libffi) _ssl/_hashlib(openssl) _lzma(xz) _uuid. Built + harvested by scripts/deps/python.sh (idempotent). M4.python-debt (2026-08-06): re-enabled the Hacl hash exts _sha3/_md5/_sha1/_blake2 — their in-tree Hacl/_blake2 sources compile DIRECTLY into libpython (only _sha2 links a prebuilt libHacl_Hash_SHA2.a; the M2.3 'Hacl won't build standalone so disable them' note was backwards) — clearing hashlib's boot-time 'code for hash md5/sha1/blake2/sha3/shake was not found' error and providing hashlib.sha3_512/shake. libpython 39.1MB->40.2MB (+1.04MB), 2850->2870 defined-T syms; a wasm-node embed verified sha3_512/shake_128/md5/sha1/blake2b/sha256 digests BYTE-IDENTICAL to native. Hacl provenance unchanged: in-tree CPython 3.13.13 (covered by the tarball MD5), no new external dep. _multiprocessing stays UNBUILT (configure resolves sem_open/sem_unlink=no — emscripten omits POSIX *named* semaphores outside its -pthread libc, and our browser libpython is single-threaded) — genuinely unbuildable, not merely disabled. A thread-backed pure-python shim (scripts/deps/python-shims/_multiprocessing.py, our GPL-2.0-or-later, installed into the harvested stdlib) makes 'from _multiprocessing import SemLock, sem_unlink' + 'import multiprocessing.synchronize' succeed (Pyodide ships no _multiprocessing and patches the consumer, but bl_pkg is pinned/read-only), so bl_pkg register no longer fails and Blender stops popping the asset-library dialog on boot.

numpy.rationale: NumPy C-extension + pure-python tree for the embedded CPython 3.13; launch-critical (M7.pre) and the sole blocker on 8 deferred tier-b suites (script_load_addons/modules + 6 sculpt/paint). BSD-3-Clause is GPL-2.0-or-later compatible.
numpy.source: versions.cmake:498 NUMPY_VERSION 2.3.4 (MD5 8717ed1828a8a390c454c6636e91c46a); built by scripts/deps/numpy.sh (release-mode / -DNDEBUG via -Db_ndebug=true since 2026-08-07)
numpy.notes: Static shape (a): 13 production C-ext modules cross-compiled with emcc 6.0.5 (JS-EH, -matomics -mbulk-memory) via numpy's vendored meson + emscripten cross file, allow-noblas + disable-optimization/threading + b_ndebug=true (RELEASE / -DNDEBUG), ZERO source patches (Pyodide also patches nothing since the meson migration). Combined -> lib/wasm/lib/libnumpy.a (dedup shared f2c lapack-lite); pure tree at lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/numpy. RELEASE REBUILD 2026-08-07 (notes/m7-numpy-release.md): the earlier build used meson's DEFAULT buildtype (=debug) so C assert() stayed compiled IN, and numpy/_core/src/multiarray/alloc.c:130 assert(PyGILState_Check()) FALSE-fired under blender's -sPROXY_TO_PTHREAD profile, aborting on the FIRST array allocation (bare np.zeros(5) died identically; it took the glTF export down, notes/m7-io-smoke.md). -Db_ndebug=true adds -DNDEBUG to every TU so the assert compiles to nothing (verified STATICALLY: 'PyGILState_Check' assert strings in libnumpy.a 3 -> 0; archive 38.8M -> 37.5M) and numpy still imports+allocates (numpy.zeros(5)/array([1,2,3]).sum()==6 GREEN in a standalone libpython node embed against the harvested archive). Harvest is now ATOMIC (temp + rename(2) for libnumpy.a; staged sibling tree + two renames for site-packages/numpy) so a concurrent link / .data repackage never observes a half-written artifact. Pure-python tree is byte-identical to the debug build (the fix rides entirely in libnumpy.a -> the .wasm; the .data repackage needs nothing special). Import gate GREEN in a standalone libpython embed under node (numpy.array([1,2,3]).sum()==6; harvested-artifact + site-packages auto-import re-verified). Driver follow-up: register the 13 PyInit_* in bpy_interface.cc inittab + link libnumpy.a into blender.js, then flip NUMPY_HARVESTED=1 (scope_m2b); the in-flight build-wasm-cycles/windowed relinks pick the fixed archive up automatically. 1 benign wasm sig warning (random_multinomial, LP32) — only affects np.random.multinomial(large n). See notes/deps-numpy.md + notes/m7-numpy-release.md.

cattrs.source: versions.cmake:444 CATTRS_VERSION 25.1.1; native installs it via build_files/build_environment/cmake/python_site_packages.cmake:35-58 (pip install --no-binary :all: into the bundled python's site-packages). Wasm mirror: scripts/deps/wheels.sh fetches the pinned py3-none-any wheel from PyPI (SHA-256 verified) and extracts it into lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/.
cattrs.rationale: bl_pkg (the extensions system) register imports cattrs on the windowed browser boot: _bpy_internal/http/downloader.py:51-52 and _bpy_internal/assets/remote_library/json_parsing.py:16-17 do `import cattrs` + `import cattrs.preconf.json`. Absent, register raises ModuleNotFoundError('No module named cattrs') and Blender pops the asset-library recovery dialog (M4 first-pixels golden pollution) — the next import in downloader.py right after the multiprocessing.synchronize gap the mp shim already closed. Pure-python (zero compiled .so, verified against the oracle's shipped tree); MIT is GPL-2.0-or-later compatible.
cattrs.notes: Extracted into lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/{cattr,cattrs} + cattrs-25.1.1.dist-info. Runtime deps: attrs (>=24.3.0) and typing_extensions (>=4.12.2, unconditional) — both harvested below; exceptiongroup is required only for python_version < '3.11' so N/A on 3.13 (confirmed absent from the oracle site-packages). These are byte-equivalent to what native Blender 5.2.0 ships (--no-binary sdist build == py3-none-any wheel for a pure-python package; same versions as the oracle). Verified: host CPython 3.13.13 AND a wasm CPython 3.13.13 node embed (build-python-probe/build-jseh, harvested site-packages NODEFS-mounted) both import cattrs + cattrs.preconf.json and complete a make_converter().loads(dumps()) attrs round-trip, all resolving from the harvested tree. scripts/deps/wheels.sh is idempotent (2nd run ~0s) + additive: it touches only the 8 paths it owns and preserves site-packages/numpy + the stdlib _multiprocessing shim (the e3c8158 protections).

attrs.source: versions.cmake:443 ATTRS_VERSION 25.3.0; native via python_site_packages.cmake:52 (pip --no-binary :all:). Wasm mirror: scripts/deps/wheels.sh (pinned py3-none-any wheel, SHA-256 verified) -> lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/{attr,attrs}.

attrs.notes: Extracted into lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/{attr,attrs} + attrs-25.3.0.dist-info. Byte-equivalent to native Blender 5.2.0's shipped attrs. Installed by scripts/deps/wheels.sh alongside cattrs; import-verified in host + wasm CPython 3.13.13 (see cattrs).

typing_extensions.rationale: cattrs' unconditional required dependency (cattrs METADATA: Requires-Dist typing-extensions>=4.12.2). Single-module pure-python (typing_extensions.py). PSF-2.0 is FSF-certified GPL-compatible — the same license family as CPython itself (already a wasm_built dep).
typing_extensions.notes: Installed as lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/typing_extensions.py + typing_extensions-4.14.1.dist-info by scripts/deps/wheels.sh. Byte-equivalent to native Blender 5.2.0's shipped copy; import-verified in host + wasm CPython 3.13.13 (see cattrs).

requests.source: versions.cmake:458 REQUESTS_VERSION 2.32.3; native installs it via python_site_packages.cmake:47 (pip install --no-binary :all:). Wasm mirror: scripts/deps/wheels.sh fetches the pinned py3-none-any wheel from PyPI (SHA-256 verified) into lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/requests.
requests.rationale: bl_pkg register imports requests on the windowed browser boot: _bpy_internal/http/downloader.py:53-54 do `import requests` + `import requests.adapters`. The next third-party import after cattrs on the same downloader.py register path. Apache-2.0 is FSF-certified compatible with GPLv3, and Blender ships requests in its own GPL-2.0-or-later aggregate (the -or-later covers GPLv3), so it is GPL-compatible for our runtime. Pure-python (zero .so vs the oracle tree).
requests.notes: Extracted into lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/requests + requests-2.32.3.dist-info by scripts/deps/wheels.sh (idempotent, additive). Import-verified: host CPython 3.13.13 AND wasm CPython 3.13.13 node embed both `import requests, requests.adapters` from the harvested tree and requests.certs.where() resolves to the harvested certifi. License Apache-2.0 confirmed from the wheel METADATA. NOTE (separate blocker, NOT a wheel gap): downloader.py:55 also `import urllib3.util.retry`; `import urllib3` runs urllib3/__init__.py:208-211 `inject_into_urllib3()` UNCONDITIONALLY when sys.platform=='emscripten' (our browser CPython), which imports `js` + `pyodide.ffi` (Pyodide runtime modules our non-Pyodide build lacks) -> ModuleNotFoundError at register. Proven the sole remaining wall in the chain (with trivial js/pyodide.ffi stubs the FULL downloader.py third-party chain imports on the wasm interpreter). This is a networking-transport decision (Pyodide-style js bridge shim vs custom emscripten fetch), flagged to the driver — see notes/python-emcc605-probe.md M4.python-debt(cont.) and ledger/deferred.json is the likely home if the extensions-download transport is deferred.

urllib3.source: versions.cmake:453 URLLIB3_VERSION 2.4.0; native via python_site_packages.cmake:45 (pip --no-binary :all:). Wasm mirror: scripts/deps/wheels.sh (pinned py3-none-any wheel, SHA-256 verified) -> lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/urllib3.
urllib3.rationale: requests' required runtime dependency AND a direct bl_pkg import (downloader.py:55 `import urllib3.util.retry`). Provides the HTTP connection pooling requests is built on. Pure-python (zero .so); MIT is GPL-2.0-or-later compatible.
urllib3.notes: Extracted into lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/urllib3 + urllib3-2.4.0.dist-info by scripts/deps/wheels.sh. License MIT confirmed from the wheel METADATA (License-Expression: MIT). CAVEAT: urllib3/__init__.py:208-211 unconditionally calls inject_into_urllib3() on sys.platform=='emscripten', importing js + pyodide.ffi (contrib/emscripten/fetch.py:45-46) — absent in our non-Pyodide CPython, so `import urllib3` raises ModuleNotFoundError('No module named js') at register on the actual wasm build (host doesn't hit it, sys.platform=='darwin'). Surfaced by the wasm node embed; it is the last blocker in the register import chain. Fix is a networking-transport decision (driver-flagged), not a wheel change; the wheel itself is correct + byte-equivalent to native.

certifi.rationale: requests' required runtime dependency (Mozilla CA root bundle; requests.certs.where() returns certifi/cacert.pem). Imported transitively when `import requests` loads requests.certs. Pure-python + a cacert.pem data file. MPL-2.0 is FSF-certified GPL-compatible.
certifi.notes: Extracted into lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/certifi + certifi-2025.4.26.dist-info by scripts/deps/wheels.sh. License MPL-2.0 confirmed from the wheel METADATA. Verified: requests.certs.where() resolves to the harvested certifi/cacert.pem in both the host and wasm embed. Byte-equivalent to native Blender 5.2.0.

toolchain._note: Build-time / host-tool / native-harness deps. These are NOT compiled into the shipped blender.wasm payload (build_time:true), so GPL-compatibility of the runtime aggregate does not depend on them; recorded for provenance + audit completeness. emdawnwebgpu is the one FUTURE runtime (browser) dep, pending M4.

emscripten.rationale: The wasm compiler toolchain (emcc/em++ 6.0.5, bundled node 22.16.0). Build-time only; emitted code carries no emscripten license obligation on the shipped wasm beyond the permissive MIT/NCSA runtime bits.
emscripten.source: oracle/TOOLCHAIN — emsdk release dbd755b5da399329c2576f6e3dfa7f419f5d8409; emcc 6.0.5 (1db513782be24469589d7cb8a1f1834e9a33f271); GOAL floor >=4.0.10

terser_public_bundle_minifier.rationale: Pinned build-time JavaScript parser/compressor for deterministic public-shell controls. It is invoked only while assembling the static public bundle and is never linked, preloaded, or shipped as a runtime library.
terser_public_bundle_minifier.notes: The assembler binds Node v22.16.0, the exact Terser package-lock integrity, and the executable dist bundle SHA-256; compression uses two passes, identifier mangling without property mangling, and preserves SPDX comments.

dawn.rationale: Dawn (native WebGPU impl) + Tint (SPIR-V reader / WGSL writer, same repo) for the M3 native gpu-module harness (GLSL->SPIR-V->Tint->WGSL->wgpuDeviceCreateShaderModule on Dawn/Metal). NOT in the wasm payload — the browser uses the emdawnwebgpu port instead. BSD-3-Clause.

glslang.rationale: GLSL->SPIR-V host tool for the M3 shader probes (glslangValidator; pulled spirv-tools 1.4.357.0 for spirv-val/dis). Build-time host tool only, NOT a runtime/browser dep. Mixed BSD-3-Clause/Apache-2.0/MIT (all GPL-compatible under GPL-2.0-or-later->GPLv3).

playwright.rationale: Host-side browser automation for strict headed WebGPU parity and release-evidence producers. Exact package versions are checked before capture; neither the Node packages nor Playwright-managed browser binaries are linked, preloaded, or shipped in the Blender Wasm/browser product.
playwright.source: npm @playwright/test@1.61.1 (exact closure: playwright@1.61.1 and playwright-core@1.61.1); notes/migration-to-ornith-lab.md; sandbox/m8-launch-gate/verify_product_bar.mjs

pngjs.rationale: Pure-JavaScript host-side PNG decoder for strict browser screenshot pixel proofs. It is exact-version checked before capture and is never linked, preloaded, or shipped in the Blender Wasm/browser product.

sharp.rationale: Host-side image transform for the strict M5 ROI-latency producer's established screenshot -> greyscale -> 160x90 resize -> raw MAD detector. It is never linked, preloaded, or otherwise shipped in the Blender Wasm/browser product.
sharp.source: npm sharp@0.35.3 and its exact Linux x64 optional packages; sandbox/m5-latency/drive-trusted-latency-roi.mjs; notes/migration-to-ornith-lab.md
sharp.notes: Sharp is Apache-2.0. The prebuilt @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64 1.3.2 package declares LGPL-3.0-or-later and reports libvips 8.18.3. Direct JS dependencies resolved for this pin are @img/colour 1.1.0 (MIT), detect-libc 2.1.2 (Apache-2.0), and semver 7.8.5 (ISC); all are host-only. The producer rejects Sharp/libvips version drift and its browser-free live self-check exercises the unchanged transform twice for determinism.

linux_browser_identity_tools.rationale: Linux-only M8 release-evidence tools. GnuPG proves the exact vendor APT-key primary fingerprint; readelf proves the canonical amd64 PIE executable; dpkg proves package ownership/version and unchanged installed files; APT proves the installed package is the vendor-repository candidate and supplies the archive SHA-256. They are never linked, preloaded, or shipped in the Blender browser product.
linux_browser_identity_tools.source: Ubuntu host packages on ornith-lab; sandbox/m8-launch-gate/runtime_evidence.mjs and verify_m8.py; notes/m8-browser-identity-linux-portability-20260820.md

linux_soak_rss_tool.rationale: Linux-only host process census for the strict M8 soak. ps supplies RSS plus command rows used to sum the dedicated branded-Chrome profile's browser, renderer, GPU, and utility processes. It is never linked, preloaded, or shipped in the Blender browser product.
linux_soak_rss_tool.source: Ubuntu procps package on ornith-lab; sandbox/m8-launch-gate/soak_current.mjs; notes/m8-soak-linux-portability-20260820.md

reuse_compliance_tool.license: Apache-2.0 AND CC0-1.0 AND CC-BY-SA-4.0 AND GPL-3.0-or-later
reuse_compliance_tool.rationale: Host-side REUSE Specification 3.3 linter for the strict M8 technical-package compliance receipt. The exact executable version and bytes are bound into generated evidence; the tool and its Python closure are never linked, preloaded, or shipped in the Blender browser product.

emdawnwebgpu.rationale: The browser WebGPU runtime binding (--use-port=emdawnwebgpu), Dawn-derived (BSD-3-Clause). Becomes a shipped RUNTIME dep at M4 (first-pixels); resolves + downloads on first use, exact port pin to be recorded when M4 pins it (see notes/gpu-shader-chain.md §5 open-question 3). Compile-only probe (--use-port=emdawnwebgpu -c) OK per oracle/TOOLCHAIN.
